text: Kabal AS is a private Norwegian logistics-software company founded in 2011 by Jan Inge Pedersen and Fredrik Larsen, headquartered in Stavanger, and backed by investor Insight Partners; no controlling owner is named by its sources.
short: Kabal AS is a private Stavanger software company founded in 2011, backed by Insight Partners.

source.quote: Kabal was founded in 2011 by Jan Inge Pedersen and Fredrik Larsen ... Backed by world-leading investor Insight Partners, Kabal is committed to innovating for logistics excellence
